summary: Added 30 unique, DOI/Crossref-verified primary empirical studies to docs/research/supervisors/psychology-primary.json spanning retrieval practice/testing effect, distributed/spaced practice, interleaving/desirable difficulty, cognitive load/working memory, feedback timing, metacognition/self-regulation, motivation/autonomy/competence, anxiety/frustration/confidence, transfer/generalization, mastery criteria/delayed assessment and age-sensitive learning. Every record was verified against the Crossref API plus a second distinct HTTPS source (PubMed, ERIC, doi.org, or a publisher/university repository) before inclusion; two candidate records with unverifiable identifiers were dropped rather than filled in, and two verificationSources entries (one invented PMID, one non-HTTPS link) were caught and corrected during self-review before finalizing.
